forest_ruins.reason: The nine-tile decorative dry patch is outside the fighting lanes: the exploratory sweep produced 0.375 reactions per battle. Keep this sparse map off rather than silently presenting an unproductive opt-in.

hollow_nest.reason: The stone chamber has no native fuel or water. Its existing web hazard still restrains; incidental web burning produced only 0.097 reactions per exploratory battle, so terrain reactions are not enabled here.

hollow_lair.reason: Four decorative boards do not form a useful reaction area in this stone boss chamber (0.431 reactions per exploratory battle). The boss's fire attacks and existing phase hazards remain unchanged.

lava.decision: Lava is deep terrain, not an ambient fire surface: it blocks walking, and forced entry uses the existing deep-fall rule (Downed for party members, death for enemies). It neither adds periodic fire damage nor ignites neighbouring fuel.
lava.rationale: Keep a single deterministic fall/ledge contract rather than silently adding a second damage model to the finale. Hazard remains an authoring tag; Deep is the mechanical flag. Any later change to the finale in #141 must explicitly replace this recorded contract.
